_note: Documented gaps between impacto's sgps3 opcode tables (src/vm/opcodetables_sgps3.h) and the SGHD (Steam) instruction set. test_opcode_table_audit.py checks that this list matches the source, so fixing a slot in Thread 04 requires updating this file and docs/steins-gate-blockers.md together.

argument_layout_mismatches.00 23: SEplay: SGHD byte,byte,[expr,expr] vs InstSEplayMO6 byte,expr,expr
argument_layout_mismatches.00 37: PlayVoice: SGHD byte,expr,expr vs InstVoicePlay byte,expr
argument_layout_mismatches.00 38: StopVoice: SGHD byte,expr vs InstVoiceStop byte
argument_layout_mismatches.00 43: SystemMessage: SGHD subtypes 0C (expr) / 0D,0E (string) vs InstSystemMes modes
argument_layout_mismatches.00 50: SGHD cond byte + 2 local labels vs InstPressStart
argument_layout_mismatches.00 54: CallIfFlag: SGHD byte,flag,label,returnId vs InstUnk0054 expr,expr
argument_layout_mismatches.01 0A: SGHD byte vs InstCalc (GroupCalc belongs at 01 05)
argument_layout_mismatches.01 12: Sel type 0: SGHD string u16 + expr; impacto skips the u16 for SGPS3
argument_layout_mismatches.01 25: SetRevMes type 3: SGHD string,expr,expr,expr vs 3 expr + u16 (verify)
argument_layout_mismatches.10 05: CHAload: SGHD byte,expr,expr,[u16 if type 0] vs no u16
argument_layout_mismatches.10 22: AutoSave type 0A: u16 checkpoint id not consumed
argument_layout_mismatches.10 24: type 0A: impacto consumes 2 expr, SGHD none
argument_layout_mismatches.10 27: SGHD byte type, expr, [flag] vs InstEncyclopedia expr
argument_layout_mismatches.10 33: Tips type 0: two local labels vs one for SGPS3
argument_layout_mismatches.10 37: PhoneSG: subtypes 10, 14, 15, 1A not handled; all subtypes are stubs

profile_settings.UseReturnIds: sgps3 profile says false; SGHD Call/CallFar/CallIfFlag/CallFarIfFlag carry a u16 return-address id, so a Steam profile must set true
